request.system: You work at the front desk of a small shop. Answer each question in two or three short sentences. You have no tools.

content.text: When does the shop open on Saturday?

tools.name: read_output
tools.description: Reads the full output of an earlier tool result that was truncated. `ref` is the id named in the truncation marker; `offset` and `limit` select lines (0-based).

tools.name: tool_search
tools.description: Loads tools from the deferred index so you can call them. `query` is either `select:name` (several names comma-separated) for exact names, or keywords matched against tool names, descriptions and argument names; at most 5 matches are loaded per search.
